SOUND_MENU: Once Upon a Time Earthbound- By PizzaPija

sounds.name: Once Upon a Time Earthbound- By PizzaPija

input0: Long ago, 2 races ruled over Earth
One day, the Furries wanted to make
technology to be the future of Earth
They wanted to keep the Earth the same
Mojos using the power of magic
The Furries were victorious and the Mojos
ran away. They hid in the 4th dimension
Planning their revenge for the future's war

MESSAGE: King Gurre & Queen Lizzy
They fought in the war and here we are now, hiding
King Baza & Queen Cindy
Baza was Gurre's son and he married Cindy
King Gensra & Queen Meii!
Mom and Dad! We live happily together!
King Kirto & Queen Millie
Millie was Baza's daughter and married Kirto
I wonder what dad have in store for me...
O-Oh... Thanks mom.. dad..
I guess so..
Alright! I will train hard today! For you and the kingdom!
We just wanted to say that today will be your 1st day of Prince training!
You will learn to fight by this afternoon!
Now now, dont be sad!
This will make you stronger!
And a good King is a strong King
Morning, my son!
Come, sit down with us and we'll talk about a few things
We are proud son! You will be a good king for the Wonderland
And you will finish the plan of Future War 2 for the Wolfjenston family
Thats my son!
Now eat up, so you will have lots of energy to train!
Okay son! There are a couple of rules you need to follow in order to fight
1) Each person must take turns, we fight it fair
2) As a royal student, you must learn magic
3) You should NEVER run away from an enemy! Be FEARLESS!

QUESTION: Got that?

MESSAGE: Good! Im going to trigger a battle! Are you ready?
Because here we go..!!

QUESTION: Ah, here we are son. A battle!
Today, Im going to teach you a MS attack!
Whats an MS you ask?
Well, it means Magic Strike of course!
Youre going to learn to use MS Fire
Attack me with it!
There you go! You got it!
Youre doing pretty well my son! I'll teach you the last magic attack I know
And that is MS Thunder! Go try it on me
There you go! You got it!
My son, you've learnt every MS attack I know! Your training for today is complete!
My son..! Are you.. feeling alright?
N-No.. it cant be!
...Were you feeling.. Feverish?
..And.. did you feel something.. awakening inside you?
...! Oh my.. my son! Go and attack me with that awakened power!
...M-My son...
Y-Youre the one.

MESSAGE: Im going back inside. You can go play with your friends outside the castle
Play safely, my son

QUESTION: No, no my son! You got it wrong! Try again
There you go! You got it!
When you use a magic attack, your PP will decrease depending on the attack youre using
If you reach 0PP, you wont be able to use anymore magic attacks!
Magic attacks are powerful, only a few Mojos master the art of MS!
When you use 'bash', it wont inflict much damage
So if you need to defeat a strong enemy, use the power of MS!
Anyways, next magic attack is MS Freeze!
This MS is strong against fire enemies!
Go and try it on me!

MESSAGE: (Wolfje sleeps here)
(Mirror mirror near the wall, whos the cutest of em all?)
(Family Picture)
Oh, good morning Prince Wolfje..!
Your father's is waiting for you to eat breakfast
I suggest you should go now, he has something to talk about as well
Ah! Young Prince, your father wanted to show you something
(Wolfje doesnt like fruit much)
(Not enough PP!)
(Not enough PP!)
(Not enough PP!)
(Not enough PP!)
Press C to see STATS & press V to see INVENTORY, press X to close them both
Oh hey young prince!
Im Kan-An's younger bro, Kir-i!
Did you know that our name means 'Left' and 'Right'?
Anyways, I heard you started training today!
Have your dad taught you that you can check your STATS pressing C?
And you can check your INVENTORY pressing 'V'!
You can check your stats while battle too!
You can press X to close them both! I hope I helped young prince!

QUESTION: (Crow-Atia A attacks!)
(Crow-Atia B attacks!)
(Make a wish?) (yes/no)
Your HP and PP is maxed out
(Oh well... pun intended)

MESSAGE: I gave you my juice already
Im still trying to get water.. REGULAR water
Im just here to get some water..!
But when I pull the bucket up, I got this weird juice-like drink
You can have it, Prince Wolfje!
Oh you already have one! Sorry your majesty!
Here you go!
Heyyy! Wolfje! Its you my man!
Me and the others want you to go to East Wonderland!
Lets go prank some Furries in the magic pond! It'll be fun!
